analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($171.09) vs SMA5/20/50 ($176.00/$180.40/$182.99) — below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($165.90/$154.64) — above long-term trends, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (61.6%) + historically mid-range price.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.0 → 38.3) — attempting oversold escape, turning bearish.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.9076 → -1.0374) — worsening, bearish signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $171.35) — approaching lower band, downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($170.83) — based on Pivot S1 ($162.11) and 20-day low ($167.54).
· Swing resistance ($180.22) — approaching SMA20 ($180.40) and Bollinger middle band ($180.40).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Failed Higher Low recovery, entering Lower High) — trend weakening.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.38x) — increased confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) — observe after confirmation of swing support at $170.83.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 연속 음봉으로 하락 추세가 이어지고 있으며, 5일 저가($167.54)가 20일 저가($167.54)와 같아 Higher Low 패턴 형성에 실패하고 Lower High 초입으로 진입하는 모습.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The downtrend continues with 5 consecutive negative daily candles, failing to form a Higher Low as the 5-day low ($167.54) matches the 20-day low ($167.54), indicating an entry into a Lower High pattern.
keyPoints: 최근 5거래일 연속 음봉 마감으로 하락세 지속.
RSI는 과매도 구간에서 반등 시도하나 MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 추세 약화.
keyPointsEn: Persistent downtrend with 5 consecutive negative daily closes.
RSI attempts oversold bounce, but MACD histogram worsens, signaling trend weakness.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 21.0으로 추세 미형성 구간에서 하락이 발생하여 충격성 변동 가능성 존재.

analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 판단(7/29)에서 RSI 과매도 탈출 시도했으나 추세 약화로 관망으로 전환했으며, 금일도 5일 연속 음봉 마감하며 하락세 지속 및 스윙 지지선 근접으로 관망 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: Maintaining a 'watchful' stance for 3 consecutive days. Shifted to 'watchful' on the previous decision (7/29) due to trend weakening despite RSI's oversold escape attempt. Today's continued decline with 5 consecutive negative closes and proximity to swing support maintains the 'watchful' stance.
